metadata.name: B1
metadata.description: the NON-SECRET auth-status probe ({status, email, userId}) — login and the supabase config live in the 👤 Profile doc (doc:identity), which defines sb.default. NOT a dependency (opening chatrooms must not pull the profile panes into this workbook): blank until you sign in over there, then every gated view here unlocks reactively when sb.default.auth is born.

metadata.name: B2
metadata.description: =view('rooms', roomspane(…)): the room list from appkit's list_conversations RPC (grok.loadrooms fills grok.rooms); a row click dispatches grok.pickroom — select + load messages + focus the room chat

metadata.name: B3
metadata.description: =view('roomchat', chatpane(…)) wired to the ROOM cels: transcript = grok.roomlog (my rows as user bubbles, others as 👤 name), composer = grok.roomq → grok.roomsend / grok.roomkey; title tracks grok.roomtitle. Pane named 'roomchat' so it never collides with chatdoc's 'chat' (=view pane names are globally idempotent).

cels.f: =view("roomchat", chatpane(grok.roomlog, grok.roomq, {project:"default", authed:signedIn(sb.default.auth), status:grok.status, title:grok.roomtitle, draftCel:"grok.roomq", send:"grok.roomsend", key:"grok.roomkey", chips:false, placeholder:"Message the room… (@*handle summons a bot)"}))

manifests.name: chatrooms
manifests.description: appkit chatrooms (a sheetapp document) — browse YOUR chatrooms, pick one, chat in it for real. Sign-in + the supabase config live in the 👤 Profile doc (doc:identity — it defines sb.default; this doc references it). Three visible cells: B1 the non-secret auth-status probe, B2 =view rooms (roomspane over the list_conversations RPC), B3 =view roomchat (chatpane wired to the room cels — sends INSERT into appkit's chat table as you; '@handle' summons appkit's bot-responder).
